description: This file is a shell script providing functions for managing NAND flash memory operations within an OpenWrt environment. It includes routines for identifying, mounting, creating, and removing UBI volumes, as well as functions for upgrading firmware images such as UBIFS, UBI, and FIT images, and verifying the integrity of upgrade files.

methods.name: ubi_mknod
methods.description: Creates a device node for a UBI volume if it does not already exist, based on the device ID stored in the volume directory.

methods.name: nand_find_volume
methods.description: Finds the UBI volume directory based on UBI device name and volume name, and sets up the device node.

methods.name: nand_find_ubi
methods.description: Finds the UBI device name associated with a given MTD partition.

methods.name: identify
methods.description: Identifies the magic number of a NAND device to determine its filesystem type or format.

methods.name: identify_tar
methods.description: Identifies the format of a tar archive within an image file.

methods.name: identify_if_gzip
methods.description: Checks whether a file is gzip compressed and identifies its format.

methods.name: nand_restore_config
methods.description: Restores configuration data from a backup into an ubifs volume.

methods.name: nand_remove_ubiblock
methods.description: Removes a ubiblock device corresponding to a given volume.

methods.name: nand_attach_ubi
methods.description: Attaches a UBI device to a MTD partition, formatting and creating volumes if necessary.

methods.name: nand_detach_ubi
methods.description: Detaches a UBI device and removes associated volumes.

methods.name: nand_upgrade_prepare_ubi
methods.description: Prepares UBI volumes for an upgrade, creating volumes for kernel, rootfs, and data as needed.

methods.name: nand_upgrade_ubinized
methods.description: Writes a ubinized UBI image to the appropriate MTD partition.

methods.name: nand_upgrade_ubifs
methods.description: Updates the UBI root filesystem volume with a new UBIFS image.

methods.name: nand_upgrade_fit
methods.description: Updates the UBI kernel volume with a FIT image.

methods.name: nand_upgrade_tar
methods.description: Extracts and writes kernel and root filesystem images from a tar archive to the appropriate MTD or UBI volumes.

methods.name: nand_verify_if_gzip_file
methods.description: Verifies the integrity of a gzip compressed upgrade file.

methods.name: nand_verify_tar_file
methods.description: Verifies the integrity of a tar archive upgrade file.

methods.name: nand_do_flash_file
methods.description: Determines the type of a firmware file and initiates the appropriate upgrade procedure.

methods.name: nand_do_restore_config
methods.description: Restores sysupgrade configuration if present.

methods.name: nand_do_upgrade
methods.description: Main function to upgrade the device firmware based on supplied image and optional extraction command.

methods.name: nand_do_upgrade_success
methods.description: Performs actions after a successful upgrade, including restoring config and rebooting.

methods.name: nand_do_upgrade_failed
methods.description: Handles failure of upgrade process, including unmounting filesystems and rebooting.

methods.name: nand_do_platform_check
methods.description: Checks whether the provided firmware file is a valid image for this platform.
